plan: [This is a single-round second-price (Vickrey) auction with three bidders and value = $48. Truthful bidding is a weakly dominant strategy: bidding my true value maximizes expected profit because it ensures I win whenever doing so yields nonnegative payoff and avoids winning at a loss. Overbidding risks negative profit; underbidding risks losing profitable wins. Therefore I will bid my value.]

[In a second-price sealed-bid auction, the dominant strategy is to bid my true private value. Bidding $38 maximizes expected payoff: it avoids overbidding regret and prevents underbidding from losing positive-profit wins. Ties are random, but truthful bidding is optimal.]

[In a second-price sealed-bid auction, bidding my true value is a dominant strategy. It ensures I never pay more than my value and maximizes expected profit: bidding higher risks negative profit if I win and pay more than value; bidding lower risks losing positive-profit wins. So I will bid 12.]
